verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's docs describe its core LLM Gateway (Proxy) as self-hosted, with virtual keys, cost tracking and an admin UI, and document a proxy CLI with worker-process configuration. A community user independently confirms running it in a homelab from the litellm/litellm Docker image. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party deployment documentation (Docker/Kubernetes install steps), and explicit evidence of which core features stay free and open when self-hosted versus enterprise-licensed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
